s1.syndrome_frame: Fetal neurological abnormalities with ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls
salient_findings: Multiple hyperechoic regions within the ventricular lumens
Areas of high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images within the ventricles
key_facts: Normal middle cerebral artery perfusion on fetal Doppler ultrasound

raw.syndrome_frame: Fetal neurological abnormalities with ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls
salient_findings: Multiple hyperechoic regions within the ventricular lumens
Areas of high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images within the ventricles
key_facts: Normal middle cerebral artery perfusion on fetal Doppler ultrasound

shortlist.label: Congenital Cytomegalovirus Infection
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls are consistent with congenital CMV infection

shortlist.label: Dandy-Walker Malformation
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls are characteristic of Dandy-Walker malformation

shortlist.label: Fetal Stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls could be indicative of fetal stroke

shortlist.label: Vein of Galen Malformation
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls may be associated with vein of Galen malformation

shortlist.label: Schizencephaly
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal ventriculomegaly and irregular ventricular walls are consistent with schizencephaly

raw.rationale: The presence of bilateral ventriculomegaly, irregular ventricular walls, and multiple hyperechoic regions within the ventricular lumens on ultrasound, along with high signal intensity on T1-weighted images and low signal intensity on T2-weighted images on fetal MRI, are consistent with the findings of congenital CMV infection, which can cause ventriculomegaly and periventricular calcifications.

rejected.label: Dandy-Walker Malformation
rejected.why: Typically characterized by hypoplasia of the cerebellar vermis and cystic dilation of the fourth ventricle, which is not described in the case.

rejected.label: Fetal Stroke
rejected.why: Would likely show areas of infarction on imaging, and the comprehensive workup did not indicate any coagulopathy or other risk factors for stroke.

rejected.label: Vein of Galen Malformation
rejected.why: Characterized by a dilated median prosencephalic vein of Markowski and high-velocity flow on Doppler, which is not mentioned in the case.

rejected.label: Schizencephaly
rejected.why: Typically involves abnormal slits or clefts in the cerebral hemispheres, which are not described in the case.
